title: Advancing Vision-based Human Action Recognition: Exploring Vision-Language CLIP Model for Generalisation in Domain-Independent Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Applying various masking strategies (random percentage-based masking, feature-specific masking of background elements, and isolation masking using a segmentation model) to video frames to evaluate the model's reliance on spurious background context (e.g., grass or a stadium) versus actual class-defining action features.
